photos_owner_check.name: photos_owner_check
photos_owner_check.value: (bottle_id IS NOT NULL) + (tasting_note_id IS NOT NULL) + (drink_log_id IS NOT NULL) <= 1

photos_scope_check.name: photos_scope_check
photos_scope_check.value: (CASE WHEN user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN cellar_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1

photos_bottle_scope_check.name: photos_bottle_scope_check
photos_bottle_scope_check.value: bottle_id IS NULL OR (cellar_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NULL)

photos_personal_owner_check.name: photos_personal_owner_check
photos_personal_owner_check.value: (tasting_note_id IS NULL AND drink_log_id IS NULL) OR (user_id IS NOT NULL AND cellar_id IS NULL)
